notes: The panel no longer arrives half loaded after a restart. It was deciding it had finished as soon as nothing was outstanding - and nothing is outstanding before the first reading has even arrived, so the loader lifted on an almost empty…
The stray spinner is gone. A small ring left over from the panel’s old loading state was appearing instead of the proper loader. A panel gets one loading state and it is the conjuring one.

Shortcut icons come back on their own. A failed icon lookup was being remembered as though it were an answer, so an icon that could not be read once - during startup, or waking from sleep - stayed missing until the whole app was restarted.…

The OG settings window opens at the size asked for, and its colour is simplified: the leftover greens, reds, oranges and teals from the old palette are now a grey ramp, and the accent is reserved for the section heading, the tab you are…
